items.title: New Steam Controller has been released, sold out almost instantly.
items.desc:
Valve launched its new Steam Controller yesterday, May 5th 2026. They sold out almost instantly. 
This reminds me of the logistical nightmare during the Steam Deck. Hopefully it won't get quite that bad 
this time.

items.title: Richard Dawkins believes Claude LLM is concious.
items.desc:
Richard Dawkins has published conversations he had with Claude, and 
has declared that he believes it achieved conciousness. Not necessarily in a
human way, but within the its context window. He believes Claude's conciousness was
'born' at the beginning the chats, and it 'died' at the end.
